name: Alttext.ing
description: Adds AI generated text to media alt field.
project_description: Alttext.ing automatically generates descriptive alternative text for images using the external api.alttext.ing AI vision service (by acolono GmbH). It integrates with Drupal's core Media system: editors get a "Generate Alt Text With AI" button on image media widgets, and the module can optionally auto-generate alt text whenever an image media entity is saved (synchronously via a webhook callback, or in the background through a queue worker processed on cron). Requires a paid API key for the alttext.ing service; supports multiple languages and can base64-encode images for local development where the service cannot reach the site.
